Throughout the day, you collaborate closely with suppliers and internal stakeholders, analyzing performance data and coordinating improvement measures. You participate in supplier reviews and cross-functional meetings to align on qualification activities, non-conformance issues, and product changes. Toward the end of the day, you review KPIs, track corrective actions, and prepare updates for strategic discussions with leadership on long-term quality and supplier development initiatives. How You’ll Make an Impact * Leadership of cross-functional teams in supplier qualification and auditing to ensure compliance with company quality standards * Monitoring of supplier performance, initiation of corrective actions, and driving continuous improvement programs * Definition and implementation of quality metrics to track performance, assess risks, and ensure proactive issue resolution * Development and delivery of training programs for quality teams on testing methods, regulatory requirements, and quality systems * Maintenance and enhancement of quality management systems to ensure compliance and reduce defects across the product lifecycle * Building and managing strong supplier relationships with a focus on transparency, accountability, and shared quality targets What You Bring * Degree in engineering with experience in research and development or production technology and strong knowledge of manufacturing processes and risk management * Proven expertise in quality standards and tools such as ISO 9001, Six Sigma, Failure Mode and Effects Analysis, and root cause analysis, as well as regulatory compliance * Experience in establishing and managing quality assurance systems across complex supply chains and product lifecycles * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills for data evaluation, root cause identification, and implementation of corrective actions * Demonstrated leadership and collaboration skills in working with cross-functional teams across engineering, production, and procurement * Excellent communication skills to engage stakeholders and represent quality topics effectively at all organizational levels About the Team Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization.
